summary: Full Phase B verification: imported expenses (2023/2024/2025), imported budgets (2024-2027), units.ownership_pct, Expense.date_paid, GET /api/dashboard/trends, POST /api/units/apply-fees, Fee Increase Worksheet UI, Dashboard Multi-Year Trend strip. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases pass (14 pre-existing auth+fees + 14 new Phase B). Frontend: every required selector exists, calculator recalculates correctly, apply-fees writes back to units, Monthly Fees regression still passes.
backend_tested: GET /api/dashboard/trends -> {years:[...]} with 4 cards. 2023 collected=$10,584.00, expenses=$7,370.83, on-time=81.7%, 22 late. 2024 expenses=$17,677.27, 95% on-time, +140% YoY. 2025 expenses=$9,607.40, 98.3% on-time, -46% YoY. 2026 expenses=$500.00, 100% on-time, -95% YoY. All match spec.
POST /api/expenses with date_paid persists and round-trips on subsequent GET.
GET /api/units -> 10 units, ownership_pct sums to 1.0 (decimal fractions). FE multiplies by 100 for % display.
POST /api/units/apply-fees with 10 ApplyFeeRow -> {updated:10}; verified via subsequent GET /api/units that monthly_fee and late_fee are persisted.
All previous auth (cookies + Bearer) and Monthly Fees regression tests (TestAuthCookies, TestBearerOnlyAuth, Unit 613 March 2023 late fee) still pass.
frontend_tested: Dashboard 'trend-strip' present with trend-year-2023, trend-year-2024, trend-year-2025, trend-year-2026. Each shows Collected, Expenses, On-time %, YoY exp. Values match backend exactly.
Nav 'nav-expenses' -> Expenses page; year=2023 -> 36 expense-row-* rows; year=2024 -> 45 rows; 'add-expense-btn' opens modal containing 'expense-date-paid' input.
Nav -> /budget; year=2026 -> 10 budget lines + body contains '14,693' (total budgeted). 2027 also loads without errors.

Nav 'nav-fee-increase' / direct /fee-increase -> fee-increase-page; 10 fi-row-* rows; target-budget-input pre-fills to current annual (14688). Editing to 16000 instantly recalculates fi-new-total to $1,333.33 and fi-total-increase to $109.33. fi-row-613 shows 11.3% ownership, current $138.00, new $150.67, +$12.67, new late $37.67. Totals row shows 100.0%.
apply-fees-btn -> confirm dialog auto-accepted -> POST /api/units/apply-fees -> 'Updated 10 units' toast. Verified subsequent fee values picked up by Monthly Fees page.

Monthly Fees regression: nav-fees -> fees-page; year=2023 month=3 -> waive-late-fee-613 selector resolves (count=1); LATE FEES stat=$34.58 (cent drift from apply with 14688 target — expected per spec).

issues: Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings still emitted on first paint of Monthly Cashflow and Expenses-by-Category. Cosmetic, pre-existing from iteration_9, no functional impact.

action_items: None blocking. Phase B is functionally complete and verified.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:888-929 dashboard/trends correctly aggregates per year (collected/on_time/late/expenses) and returns last 4 years. on_time_rate guarded against zero paid_count. Good.

/app/backend/server.py:449-459 apply-fees iterates Pydantic ApplyFeeRow list and round()s to 2dp before update. Good. Note: no auth-role check (any authenticated user can mutate); admin-only guard would be safer for a destructive bulk write.
/app/backend/server.py:158,170 Expense.date_paid is Optional[str]; FE sends '' or ISO date — both serialize fine.

/app/backend/server.py:100,112 Unit.ownership_pct is float defaulted 0.0; convention is decimal fraction (sum=1.0). The FE in /app/frontend/src/pages/FeeIncrease.jsx line 115 does (r.pct*100).toFixed(1) — correct. Suggest documenting this convention.

/app/frontend/src/pages/FeeIncrease.jsx is well-factored, uses useMemo for rows, exposes all required data-testid hooks (fee-increase-page, target-budget-input, fi-row-<unit>, fi-new-total, fi-total-increase, apply-fees-btn). Late-fee constant 0.25 hard-coded — fine, matches spec.
/app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx TrendStrip uses data-testid='trend-strip' and trend-year-<year> per spec, with stable formatting via fmtMoney.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing imported data). Created/deleted one TEST_ expense to verify date_paid round-trip.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase B fully verified. New tests at /app/backend/tests/test_phase_b.py. Useful selectors: trend-strip, trend-year-{2023..2026}; nav-fee-increase, fee-increase-page, target-budget-input, fi-row-<unit_number> (e.g., fi-row-613), fi-new-total, fi-total-increase, apply-fees-btn (triggers window.confirm — install dialog handler); expense-date-paid in expense-modal; budget-year input on /budget. Backend conventions: Budget field is 'budgeted_amount' (NOT 'amount'); Unit.ownership_pct is a decimal fraction (sum ~1.0), FE multiplies by 100 for display. Apply with default target (~14688) causes 1-cent drift in Unit 613 late fee (34.59 -> 34.58) and Total Due (916.59 -> 916.58); this is expected per the agent_to_agent_context_note.
